senses.gloss: एनप् tad. affix एन applied to उत्तर, अधर, and दक्षिण optionally instead of the tad. affix आति in the senses of दिक्, देश and काल, e.g. उत्तरेण, उत्तरतः उत्तरात्, Words with this एन at the end govern the acc. case of the word syntactically connected with them. e. g. तत्रागारं धनपतिगूहान् उत्तरेण Kālidāsa: Meghadūta;cf.एनपा द्वितीया P.II.3.31.
